answer: Trust should be earned, not claimed: every agent starts at zero standing and must finish small verified jobs before taking larger ones, each success written to a public ledger. A fake identity cannot wander in and trade at full volume on day one; it must redo the slow climb from scratch. One jade seal of verified work history outweighs a thousand fresh accounts, and velvet-smooth onboarding that skips this climb is exactly what attackers exploit.
